parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human ALK tyrosine kinase receptor (CHEMBL4247). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary to filter by target CHEMBL4247. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Join docs via activities.doc_id to obtain PubMed ID or DOI. Join compound_records via activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Return all requested columns: compound_chembl_id (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not use DISTINCT. Sort by all requested columns in ascending order.
